notes.title: Hainya World EA 2.0 Major Update!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=E-9_T3_MRls;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3][b]Hainya World EA 2.0 Major Update![/b][/h3]
After a whole year of development, it's finally here!
We've revamped many game mechanics, significantly enhanced the visuals, and added even more fun gameplay elements!

Welcome to the Hainya World!

An RPG of Adventure x Creation!
Dig, build, battle, and explore!
Fight monsters, level up, break terrain, and gather materials to build your own base!
The kingdom is under attack by monsters!
To save it, adventurers set off to explore an ancient continent in search of untold mysteries!


Venture into the Unknown

Ancient Land
A forgotten ancient continent, where adventurers journey to investigate abnormal monster activity. Here, they can freely alter the terrain and construct structures to explore this unknown region.

Narus Continent
The homeland of adventurers and the main continent where the hainyaworld people live. It is home to many prosperous towns and residents. You can visit this land and interact with its people!

More Equipment & Skills
A more diverse equipment system, with the ability to change weapon skills!

Over 15 combat-style weapon types:
﹝Sword & Shield, Greatsword, Axe﹞
﹝Spear, Dual Blades, Daggers, Katana, Gauntlets﹞
﹝Shortbow, Short Staff, Longbow, Long Staff, Holy Book, Dual Crossbows﹞
﹝Handgun, Shotgun, Sniper Rifle, Assault Rifle﹞
Over 100 unique weapons
Over 100 types of equipment
200 unique skills and techniques

An improved, easy-to-learn combat system—switch between different weapon styles at any time!



Battle Powerful Enemies and Claim Your Loot!
Haya World is filled with formidable foes!
Level up and upgrade your gear to take them on.
They carry rich rewards just waiting to be claimed!

More Fun-Filled Systems

Fashion-A new fashion system to make your character shine even more!

Pets-Collect over 10 types of companions!

Companions-You're never alone—team up with over 30 unique companions on your journey!

Vehicles-Ride in style—explore the vast world with 20 different vehicle styles!

Fishing-Become a master angler—catch over 50 types of fish!

Farming-Live off the land—grow crops and farm in your own base!


Controller Support
You can enjoy Haya World with an Xbox controller—no additional setup required!
The game is also fully playable on Steam Deck.

Online Co-op
Team up with friends through Steam's online features~
Adventure together, create together!
Build your own unique Haya World together!

notes.title: Hainya World Notice – February 2025
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ucAE45i.png[/img]

[h1][b]Hey everyone! 
We're the Hainya World Production Team![/b][/h1]
Sorry to keep you all waiting again!......again?
We were so focused on developing the game that we overlooked how long you all have been waiting. We're truly sorry!
The changes were just too massive.
It's practically a full remake... so we couldn't release an update in a short time. We're truly sorry!
After careful consideration, our team decided that rather than rushing a small update, it's better to refine the game for a better player experience.
The current progress of EA 2.0 is around 80%
We believe it won’t be long before we can share it with you!


[h2][u]▼EA2.0 Hainya World update status!▼[/u][/h2]


[h2]New Game Graphics[/h2]
We've improved the darkness issue by enhancing the overall lighting and camera field of view.
We've enhanced the background scene processing to make the overall visuals more immersive and vibrant.

[h2]A Complete Main Story[/h2]
Players can experience an all-new story mode in the world of Haiya.
From character creation to thrilling adventures, explore every region!
The main storyline is currently 80% complete!

[h2]Controller Support – Xbox Controller & Steam Deck[/h2]
You can play seamlessly with an Xbox controller, no extra setup needed!
Hainya World is also fully playable on the Steam Deck.

[h2]New Combat Mode & System Optimization[/h2]
With the experience gained from the previous EA version, we’ve streamlined the combat system by removing the class system.
Now, combat is driven by weapon-based skills.
We've also improved connection stability and optimized the UI.
Additionally, the level cap has been increased to 80!

[h2]New Map Exploration & Combat[/h2]
A creation area twice as large and 10 new adventure zones
Over 150 new enemies added
More than 10 new boss enemies introduced

[h2]More Equipment & Skills[/h2]
A more diverse equipment system, with the ability to change weapon skills!

Over 15 combat-style weapon types:
﹝Sword & Shield, Greatsword, Axe﹞
﹝Spear, Dual Blades, Daggers, Katana, Gauntlets﹞
﹝Shortbow, Short Staff, Longbow, Long Staff, Holy Book, Dual Crossbows﹞
﹝Handgun, Shotgun, Sniper Rifle, Assault Rifle﹞
Over 100 unique weapons
Over 100 types of equipment
200 unique skills and techniques

[h2]More Fun-Filled Systems[/h2]
[b]Creation-[/b]New building types to make your base more magnificent—invite NPC companions to live with you!

[b]Combat-[/b]An improved, easy-to-learn combat system—switch between different weapon styles at any time!

[b]Adventure-[/b]A thrilling main story and quests for a complete Haiya World experience!

[b]Fashion-[/b]A new fashion system to make your character shine even more!

[b]Pets-[/b]Collect over 10 types of companions!

[b]Companions-[/b]You're never alone—team up with over 30 unique companions on your journey!

[b]Vehicles-[/b]Ride in style—explore the vast world with 20 different vehicle styles!

[b]Fishing-[/b]Become a master angler—catch over 50 types of fish!

[b]Farming-[/b]Live off the land—grow crops and farm in your own base!

[h2]Q&A Collected During This Time[/h2]
Q: Is the game dead?
A: Not at all! Since we’ve made a lot of changes, we couldn’t update it little by little. Instead, we’re planning to deliver a brand-new experience all at once!

Q: Are the new maps for creation and adventure separate?
A: No, the maps are integrated, allowing players to move seamlessly between them.

Q: Will the original creation world still be available?
A: Yes, your saved data will be preserved. However, all new content will be in the new world, so we recommend creating a new world for the best experience.

Q: The screen is too dark! It’s scary!
A: We’ve adjusted the lighting and visuals. Now, darkness effects only appear in underground caves.

Q: I feel like I have no goal in this game. What am I supposed to do?
A: We've added a new story mode! Players can follow the storyline to progress through the game, and you can also complete daily quests to earn rewards.

Q: Do I need to restart my character?
A: No, but due to the removal of the class system and the level cap increase, character levels and equipment will be adjusted. Fashion item draws have also been changed, so they will need to be redrawn. We recommend creating a new character for the best experience.

Q: Will there be new jobs?
A: No, we have removed the job system and replaced it with weapon-based combat styles.

Q: Are there still class skills?
A: Since jobs have been removed, all skills are now tied to weapons.
Each weapon has three types of moves: Attacks, Skills, and Ultimate Techniques.
Players can switch weapons freely at any time during gameplay.

Q: Has the combat feel improved?
A: Yes! We’ve optimized the combat system—attack speed has been increased, and ranged weapons now have auto-aim assistance!

Q: Constantly switching during combat feels troublesome. Will this be improved?
A: Yes! We've simplified combat—now, you can attack directly by using weapons from the quick slot.

Q: Can equipment now be enchanted?
A: Yes! Equipment can now be enchanted, and weapons can use skill stones to change their skills.

Q: Has online connectivity been optimized?
A: Yes! Previously, players had to wait when friends joined, but now they can enter the world instantly. However, if you disconnect right after joining, it may be due to an IP conflict, which requires an IP reset.

Q: Can I play with a joystick?
A: You can use the Xbox joystick to play! The game interface also has adjustments for the joystick.

Q: How does SteamDeck work?
A: It can run, but the graphics quality may need to be set to medium.

[h3][b]Q:So...when will the update be?[/b][/h3]
[h3][b]A:We are currently planning to conduct a new Beta test around May.
Stay tuned for our latest updates![/b][/h3]

We've added a new story mode! Players can follow the storyline to progress through the game, and you can also complete daily quests to earn rewards.

tags.balance_change: No, but due to the removal of the class system and the level cap increase, character levels and equipment will be adjusted.
Fashion item draws have also been changed, so they will need to be redrawn.
No, we have removed the job system and replaced it with weapon-based combat styles.
Since jobs have been removed, all skills are now tied to weapons.

tags.feature: Each weapon has three types of moves: Attacks, Skills, and Ultimate Techniques.
Players can switch weapons freely at any time during gameplay.
Yes! We’ve optimized the combat system—attack speed has been increased, and ranged weapons now have auto-aim assistance!
Yes! We've simplified combat—now, you can attack directly by using weapons from the quick slot.
Yes! Equipment can now be enchanted, and weapons can use skill stones to change their skills.
Yes! Previously, players had to wait when friends joined, but now they can enter the world instantly.
You can use the Xbox joystick to play! The game interface also has adjustments for the joystick.
